## Curated resolutions (documented evidence)
- **CASE-PUMP-010**: `Impeller and casing` -> `Hydraulic End`. M06 component reference (m06_equipment_component_reference): both 'Impeller' (PUMP.HYDR.IMPL), 'Impeller and Casing Volute' (PUMP.HYDR.RECR) and 'Impeller and Wear Rings' (PUMP.HYDR.WEAR) belong to subsystem 'Hydraulic End' for EQ-PUMP; no other EQ-PUMP subsystem lists an impeller or casing component. Subsystem only: component_name and taxonomy_code stay NULL because the case could map to PUMP.HYDR.IMPL or PUMP.HYDR.RECR (ambiguous). Reviewer: Group 1 (domain) - confirmation requested.
